{{Quote|''[R2-D2 loudly clicks and beeps]<br />"''You say the crystals are always found near a smelly orange fungus.|quotestart=0|R2-D2 and C-3PO|<ref name="Shiny" />}}
A type of large '''fungus''' grew near deposits of [[space crystal]]s, including at the mouth of a deep [[Cave/Legends|cave]] on a [[Unidentified planet (space crystals)|terrestrial planet]]. It was [[Color/Legends|orange]]-colored and had an unpleasant smell.<ref name="Shiny" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Do ''you'' dare to scratch and sniff the fungus?|''Shiny as a Droid'', addressing the reader|<ref name="Shiny" />}}
The fungus appeared in [[Shiny as a Droid: Things to See, Touch, and Smell from a Galaxy Far, Far Away|''Shiny as a Droid'']], a [[1986]] children's book written by [[Virginia Holt]] and illustrated by [[Feito]]. The top of fungus was one of the interactive elements in the book that the reader could scratch and sniff.<ref name="Shiny" />
